title: Partitions – Framing (before boarding)
status: Draft spot check from ITPs – for agreement

questions.q: Is the wall type, location and fire/acoustic rating as per the approved wall type drawings?
questions.source: Errigal ITP – setting out & wall type

questions.q: Is the deflection head to the approved detail, with the 20 mm deflection allowance?
Are head and base track fixings at the correct centres and first fixing distance from the track end?
Are stud centres and extra framing at openings as per the wall type drawings?
Are pattresses and noggins in for all fixtures (per ERR 22-series drawings)?
Are back boxes and hockey sticks in the coordinated positions, with acoustic boxes where required?
Are service openings per the BWIC drawings and framed out?
Head/base track fixings with at least 35 mm embedment?
questions.source: Errigal ITP checklist – head & base tracks

questions.q: Door frame-to-wall gaps over 10 mm sealed with approved acrylic intumescent?
Door stop fixings: steel screws into studs by at least 35 mm?
